p: $10-20. Serves Chinese cuisine mainly. It is the most popular and well known Chinese restaurant within the area. It is BYO Wine only with no corkage, and there is a bottle shop just down the road. It is approximately a 3-5 minute walk…
The restaurant looks plain and drab but the South Indian dishes are reasonable for budget eaters.
The local kebab shop serving pide, pizzas and halal snack packs as well, all with generous amounts of filling.
